context:
Follow the Trino adapter pattern (benchbox/platforms/trino.py:110-303):
  - Read verify_ssl (default True) and ssl_cert_path from config
  - Pass verify=ssl_cert_path if set, else verify=verify_ssl to each requests call
No shared HTTP mixin exists yet - add the TLS logic directly to each adapter's
upload method (doris.py _stream_load, starrocks/adapter.py, influxdb/client.py).
Use lazy-imported `_requests` already present in doris.py; replicate that pattern
in StarRocks and InfluxDB if not already there.
description:
Add verify_ssl and ca_cert_path options to HTTP-based data loading endpoints.
Currently these platforms load data over HTTP without certificate validation
options. Users deploying with self-signed certs or strict TLS policies need
these controls.

Deferred from platform-adapter-http-tls-support (completed, status anomaly -
all work done but marked "Not Started").

anti_patterns.instead: instead only pass verify=ca_cert_path when ca_cert_path is explicitly set in config
anti_patterns.why: it breaks environments that don't have the cert file at that path
the Trino adapter already uses ca_cert_path as the config key

anti_patterns.dont: set verify=False globally on a Session or module-level
anti_patterns.instead: instead pass verify= only to the specific PUT/POST upload call
anti_patterns.why: it silently disables SSL for every subsequent request in the process

preserves.behavior: All current platform adapter tests pass unchanged
Existing HTTP loading continues to work without any TLS config (backwards-compatible defaults)
